hook: *Seven years* of pillars, no bridge: Malakpet's Metro-rail link waits
hook_b: *Seven years* of pillars, no bridge: Malakpet's Metro-rail link waits
tldr: Residents say a foot overbridge linking Malakpet Metro station to the railway station near Sri Krupa Market is still in limbo seven years after its pillars went up.

beats.what: The planned bridge would add stairs, an escalator and a lift on railway land, giving the Metro station a second entry.
beats.why: The station has one entry with stairs and an often broken escalator, and no lift, residents told TOI.
beats.care: If you change between Metro and train at Malakpet, you still take the longer road route between the two stations.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: GHMC officials did not respond to TOI; residents say departments cite pending approvals and poor coordination.

cards.q: How do you get between Malakpet Metro and the railway station?

qs: Who owns the delay when a project crosses Metro, GHMC and railway land?
Do other busy Metro stations have second entries?

facts.t: Malakpet Metro has *one* entry on this side, with no lift.

viz.verdict: A link between two stations still waiting on approvals

learn.t: FOB = foot overbridge, a pedestrian bridge over a road or track

watch: Railway Board clearance; the railway station is also being redeveloped under the Amrit Bharat scheme.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Seven years on, Malakpet commuters still await Metro-rail footbridge

fact: Malakpet's Metro-to-railway footbridge pillars have stood unfinished for *seven years*
twist: An RTI reply shows the file is stuck awaiting Railway Board clearance in Delhi.
